name: klay11
caption:
DOWN 8 IN THE 4TH. THEN KLAY. 🎮🏀 Facing elimination in OKC, down 8 going into the fourth.

• Game 6, 2016 West finals, May 28, 2016
• Thunder up 83-75 after three quarters
• Klay: 11 threes (the playoff record at the time) and 41 points
• We win 108-101 and force Game 7

Klay's greatest game ever? 👇

beats.head: DOWN 8. THEN KLAY.
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: Down eight in the fourth, facing elimination in Oklahoma City. Then Klay happened.

beats.head: GAME 6
beats.name: THUNDER
beats.vo: Game six of the twenty sixteen West finals. The Thunder lead the series three to two.

beats.head: KLAY TIME
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: Then Klay Thompson goes off. Eleven threes, the playoff record at the time. Forty-one points.

beats.head: WE SURVIVE
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: We win, one-oh-eight to one-oh-one. Game seven.

beats.head: KLAY'S BEST?
beats.vo: Klay's greatest game ever? Comment below.

facts.claim: Game 6, 2016 Western Conference finals, May 28, 2016 at Oklahoma City: Thunder led the series 3-2 (Warriors forced a seventh game / Game 7 with the win). Thunder led 83-75 after three quarters (down 8 going into the fourth). Thompson made a playoff-record 11 3-pointers and scored 41 points; Warriors won 108-101. Trailing entering the 4th quarter. 11 threes was the playoff record at the time (since broken).
